examples.chinese: 晚安！希望你有個好夢。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.
examples.english: Good night! I hope you have a good dream.

items.wordHook: 晚(evening) + 安(peaceful) → a peaceful evening to you: 晚安 is good night.

examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去學校？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去圖書館？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
examples.english: What time will you go to the library?

examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 你昨天幾點回家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
examples.english: What time did you go home yesterday?

examples.chinese: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
examples.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
examples.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

examples.chinese: 一枝筆幾塊錢？
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī bǐ jǐ kuài qián?
examples.english: How much is a pen?

examples.chinese: 一枝筆幾塊錢？
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī bǐ jǐ kuài qián?
examples.english: How much is a pen?

examples.chinese: 你的房間裡有幾張椅子？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng yǐzi?
examples.english: How many chairs are there in your room?

examples.chinese: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 我有幾個台灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have several Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 你家在幾樓？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā zài jǐ lóu?
examples.english: Which floor is your home on?

examples.chinese: 你會說幾種語言？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
examples.english: How many languages can you speak?

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: 這幾個數學問題我都不懂，不知道怎麼算。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge shùxué wèntí wǒ dōu bù dǒng, bù zhīdào zěnme suàn.
examples.english: I don't understand any of these math problems; I don't know how to calculate them.

examples.chinese: 這個公園裡有幾棵又高又大的樹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē yòu gāo yòu dà de shù.
examples.english: In this park there are several tall and big trees.

examples.chinese: 如果你不想吃飯，可以只吃幾個餃子。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng chī fàn, kěyǐ zhǐ chī jǐ gè jiǎozi.
examples.english: If you don't want to eat rice, you can just eat a few dumplings.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
examples.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!
examples.english: Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.
examples.english: These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū, nà běn shū yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: Professor Wang has an old book; that book already has several hundred years of history.

examples.chinese: 這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.
examples.english: This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假去國外旅行或是學語言。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng shǔjià qù guówài lǚxíng huòshì xué yǔyán.
examples.english: Many college students use summer vacation to travel abroad or learn languages.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 畢業後能順利找到好工作，是很多大學生的希望。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu néng shùnlì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò, shì hěn duō dàxuéshēng de xīwàng.
examples.english: Being able to smoothly find a good job after graduation is the hope of many university students.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhōuwéi dōu shì hǎi, hái yǒu bùshǎo měilì de hǎitān.
examples.english: Taiwan is surrounded by sea, and there are also many beautiful beaches.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìjì dōu yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng: chūnjì shí píngyuán yǒu huāhǎi, xiàjì shí hǎitān yǒu rìchū, qiūjì shí shānqū yǒu hóngshù, dōngjì shí gāoshān yǒu báixuě, dōu shífēn mírén.
examples.english: Our country has beautiful scenery in all four seasons: in spring, the plains have seas of flowers; in summer, the beaches have sunrises; in autumn, the mountains have red trees; in winter, the high mountains have white snow—all are very charming.

examples.chinese: 我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē qùnián qǔle Yīngguó tàitai, wǒmen dōu hǎo xǐhuān zhè wèi měilì de dàsǎo.
examples.english: My eldest brother married a British wife last year; we all really like this beautiful sister-in-law.

examples.chinese: 錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiǎojiě dài de nà fù ěrhuán jiù xiàng xīngguāng yīyàng měilì, tīngshuō nà shì zǔmǔ liú gěi tā de huíyì.
examples.english: That pair of earrings Miss Qian is wearing is as beautiful as starlight; I heard that they are a memory her grandmother left to her.

examples.chinese: 他利用石頭、木頭在山上建了一間美麗的小屋。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng shítou, mùtou zài shān shàng jiàn le yī jiān měilì de xiǎowū.
examples.english: He used stones and wood to build a beautiful little house on the mountain.

examples.chinese: 當我們爬上那座高山，看見美麗的日出時，大家都驚訝地張大了嘴巴。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒmen pá shàng nà zuò gāo shān, kànjiàn měilì de rìchū shí, dàjiā dōu jīngyà de zhāng dà le zuǐbā.
examples.english: When we climbed up that high mountain and saw the beautiful sunrise, everyone opened their mouths wide in surprise.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngcháng de shēnghuó zuòxī, duì shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A normal daily schedule is very important for both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián qī de xīnlǐ biànhuà xiāngdāng dà, xūyào fùmǔ jí lǎoshī duō guānxīn.
examples.english: During the adolescent period, psychological changes are quite large, and parents and teachers need to care more.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
examples.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 吃太多炸的東西，對身體會有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō zhà de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ huì yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Eating too much fried food will have a bad influence on your health.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
examples.pinyin: Chúshīmen dōu huì hǎohǎo bǎoyǎng tāmen de yòngjù, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng zuò cài de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: Chefs all take good care of their utensils, so as to avoid affecting the quality of their cooking.

examples.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

examples.chinese: 林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shì wǒ de gāozhōng dǎoshī, zài xuéxí shàng yěshì yǐngxiǎng wǒ zuì shēn de rén.
examples.english: Teacher Lin was my high school homeroom teacher and is also the person who has influenced me most in my studies.

examples.chinese: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng xiǎobiàn de shíhou qiānwàn bié rěnnài, fǒuzé duì jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: When you need to urinate, never hold it in, otherwise the impact on your health is considerable.

examples.chinese: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
examples.pinyin: Rén de xìnggé zhǔyào shì shòu chéngzhǎng huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng, gēn xìngbié méiyǒu tài dà de guānxi.
examples.english: A person's personality is mainly influenced by their growing environment, and has little to do with gender.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
examples.pinyin: Bǎocún shíwù de fāngshì huì yǐngxiǎng shíwù de xīnxiān chéngdù.
examples.english: The way of preserving food will affect the freshness of the food.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 這件大衣的設計很簡單，可是穿起來很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī de shèjì hěn jiǎndān, kěshì chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The design of this coat is very simple, but it looks good when you put it on.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ guǎnggào shèjì de nàme xiǎo, zhèyàng de xuānchuán zěnme huì yǒu xiàoguǒ ne?
examples.english: You designed the advertisement so small; how could such promotion be effective?

examples.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
examples.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
examples.pinyin: Lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de jùyuàn, shì qǐng zhùmíng shèjìshī lái shèjì de.
examples.english: The theater not far from my home was designed by a famous designer.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēibāo zài shèjì shàng méi shénme tèsè, zhǐshì yìnle mǒu wèi míngxīng suíshǒu huà de tú, méi xiǎngdào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán, shízài yǒudiǎnr kuāzhāng.
examples.english: This backpack has nothing distinctive in its design; it just has a picture casually drawn by some celebrity printed on it. I never expected it to sell for over ten thousand dollars—that's really a bit outrageous.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī lìyòng shàng diànshì de jīhuì, zhǎnshì tā jīnnián shèjì de fúzhuāng.
examples.english: The designer used the opportunity of appearing on TV to display the clothing he designed this year.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

examples.chinese: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
examples.pinyin: Měi miàn guóqí dōu dàibiǎo yī ge guójiā, érqiě shèjì shàng dōu jùyǒu dútè de yìyì.
examples.english: Every national flag represents a country, and each has a unique meaning in its design.

examples.chinese: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。
examples.pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn réncái, guǎnggào qǐyè tígōng jiǎngjīn gěi yōuxiù de shèjìshī.
examples.english: In order to attract talent, advertising companies offer bonuses to outstanding designers.

items.wordHook: Combining 設(build) and 計(calculate): 設計 means design.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng shíwù cáiliào, jiù néng yǒuxiào de jiǎnshǎo chúyú.
examples.english: If food materials can be used well, kitchen waste can be effectively reduced.

examples.chinese: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gèng yǒuxiào de lìyòng dìqiú zīyuán, wǒ nìngyuàn jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de shēnghuó xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In order to use Earth's resources more effectively, I would rather reduce unnecessary life pleasures.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
examples.pinyin: É yī kàndào mòshēngrén jiù huì dàjiào, suǒyǐ xiāngcūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāngchéng gǒu lái kānjiā.
examples.english: As soon as a goose sees a stranger, it will honk loudly, so in the countryside some people treat geese like dogs to guard the house.

examples.chinese: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de dàxíng yànhuì huódòng, yīxiàng shì xuānchuán bùmén fùzé chǔlǐ de.
examples.english: Our company's large-scale banquet events have always been handled by the publicity department.

examples.chinese: 我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xué de wǔdǎo hěn fùzá, cháng wàng le shénme shíhou qiánjìn huò hòutuì.
examples.english: The dance I'm newly learning is very complicated; I often forget when to move forward or backward.

examples.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
examples.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
examples.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

examples.chinese: 我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huà xiān shuō zài qiántou, yàoshi nǐ bù zhào tā suǒ shuō de qù zuò, děng hòutou chū le wèntí, qíngkuàng kě jiù gèng fúzá le.
examples.english: I'll say this first (up front): if you don't do as he says, when problems arise later, the situation will become even more complicated.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

items.wordHook: Combining 主(master) and 角(angle): 主角 means leading role character, role.
a 勹(wrap) holds a 口(mouth) snugly → one short 句(sentence).
右(right) + 邊(side) → the right side: 右邊.
一(one) plank is placed 丄(above) the frame → sturdy 工(labor).
a 口(mouth) swallows 一(one) ray of light → 日(day).
Combining 暫(temporary) and 時(time): 暫時 means temporarily.
a 木(tree) shelf takes a 旦(dawn) lamp → ready to 查(look up) the answer.
